home.title: AIDOS Workbench
home.subtitle: The AI development OS, KRD method. Truth is yours; the agent writes the implementation; the harness holds the wall.
home.panelsLead: Explore the read-only projections of the truth AIDOS governs.
home.contractDescription: The per-step loop and granularity rule, versioned and machine-readable.
home.storeDescription: The Archive's content-addressed, append-only store: objects by hash, head pointer, and head history.
home.footer: Read-only projections. Truth lives in Postgres, out of the agent's reach; writes flow through an approved changeset.

store.title: Content store
store.intro: Content-addressed, append-only. Objects are stored by SHA-256 hash; editing produces a new hash while the old one stays readable. The head is a mutable pointer; its moves are an append-only history.
store.liveTitle: Read live from the aidos Postgres (schema archive)
store.demoTitle: Postgres unreachable — showing the demo fixture
store.footer: Source: live archive schema in Postgres. The panel can now write — but only the content store, below the wall (append-only); truth (kernel/mirrors/fitness) stays out of reach. The canonical door remains the store MCP server (ADR 0009).
store.putHint: Content is stored by SHA-256 hash (idempotent). Identical input returns the same hash with no new row.
store.setHeadHint: Point a head key at an existing hash and append a history row. Use the hash returned by a recent store.
store.setHeadEmpty: Provide a key and a hash.
store.setHeadFailed: Move failed (the hash must already exist in the store).
store.dbUnreachable: Postgres unreachable — write not possible. No data changed.

contract.title: Execution contract
contract.footer: Source: <source>docs/implementation_contract.md</source> — read-only projection. Changes require a ChangeSet (DRAFT → APPLIED) and a semver bump.

records.title: Records
records.intro: The seven KRDCore record kinds — content-addressed, append-only, JSONB. These tables are truth, ABOVE the wall: the agent role has SELECT only. This screen reads them; it never writes any. The only write door is the governed propose → ChangeSet → human-approval flow (coming, S20).
records.liveTitle: Read live from the aidos Postgres (schemas ideas/kernel/mirrors/changesets/dag)
records.demoTitle: Postgres unreachable — showing the demo examples
records.aboveTitle: Human-anchored truth, out of the agent's reach — written only via an approved ChangeSet.
records.belowTitle: Candidate below the freeze (Idea) — promoted toward truth via the idea → mirror → /goal flow.
records.proposeHint: The wall (CLAUDE.md §2): truth is never written directly from the screen. A write goes through propose → ChangeSet → human approval.
records.soonTitle: The ChangeSet engine arrives at S20 (idea-intake at S27) — the control is present but disabled.
records.proposeNote: The governed write path — propose → ChangeSet → human approval — is not built yet (ChangeSet engine at S20, idea-intake at S27). The control is present to make the capability reachable, but disabled; it writes nothing. The wall holds: the screen never touches kernel/mirrors/ideas.
records.footer: Source: live ideas/kernel/mirrors/changesets/dag schemas in Postgres — READ-ONLY projection (the agent role has SELECT only). Truth is written only via an approved ChangeSet through the aidos role; never from the Workbench.
